meta.meta_description: How PPC Guru grows an HVAC company across Google and Meta Ads — high-intent search calls plus a high-volume Meta lead pipeline, working together.

headline: How PPC Guru Grows an HVAC Company Across Google and Meta Ads
summary_line: PPC Guru runs EcoCare Home Comfort's HVAC advertising across both Google and Meta. Google Search captures homeowners actively looking for service — mostly phone calls — while Meta builds a high-volume lead pipeline. Together the two channels give the company both immediate high-intent enquiries and scalable demand, each tracked to genuine leads.
client_context: EcoCare Home Comfort is a Canadian HVAC and home-comfort company. Its customers fall into two groups: homeowners with an urgent need (a failing furnace or AC) who search Google and want to call now, and a much larger group who can be reached earlier on Facebook and Instagram with a maintenance or install offer. PPC Guru runs both channels so EcoCare covers the whole funnel.
background: EcoCare launched on Meta with PPC Guru in August 2025 and added a managed Google Ads account in late 2025. Rather than treat them separately, PPC Guru runs them as one HVAC growth programme: Google for bottom-of-funnel intent, Meta for volume and demand generation — each measured on genuine leads, not clicks.
analysis: The plan was to match each channel to what it does best. On Google, track calls as the primary conversion and target urgent service searches. On Meta, run instant lead forms with a clear offer and scale reach as cost per lead held up. Keep both measured on genuine enquiries so budget can move to whichever channel is delivering.
analysis_points: Google: track phone calls as the primary conversion; target urgent HVAC service searches.
Meta: run instant lead forms with a clear seasonal offer; scale reach on proven cost per lead.
Measure both channels on genuine leads (calls / forms), excluding vanity actions.
Shift budget toward whichever channel delivers the best cost per genuine lead.

changes.why: Google for high-intent service calls; Meta for high-volume demand generation.
HVAC intent is phone-led, so calls are the primary conversion.
Low-friction enquiries that scale reach affordably.
Spend shifts to the channel delivering the best genuine cost per lead.

benchmark: Meta drives volume (spend scaled from about $600 to over $10,000 a month as the lead pipeline grew), while Google contributes fewer but higher-intent phone leads — roughly 7 in 10 of EcoCare's Google leads are direct calls.

spotlight.title: Why HVAC Needs Both Channels
spotlight.body: A homeowner whose furnace just failed searches Google and calls immediately — that's high-intent, and Google captures it. But most homeowners aren't in crisis today; they can be reached earlier on Facebook and Instagram with a tune-up or install offer, building a pipeline for the weeks ahead. Running both, measured on genuine leads, means EcoCare captures urgent demand and creates new demand — and PPC Guru can move budget to whichever channel is converting best at any point in the season.

lessons: Treat Google and Meta as one programme — intent capture plus demand generation.
On Google, track phone calls as the primary conversion; HVAC is phone-led.
On Meta, use instant lead forms with a clear seasonal offer to build volume.
Measure both channels on genuine leads so you can move budget to the best performer.
Expect a higher cost per lead on Google calls — they are worth more per job.
why_it_worked: Each channel matched to what it does best in the HVAC funnel.
Call tracking on Google so budget targets urgent, phone-led demand.
Scalable Meta lead forms building a high-volume pipeline.
Budget that follows genuine cost per lead across channels.
outcome: EcoCare Home Comfort now runs a full-funnel HVAC programme: about 14 high-intent phone leads a month from Google Search and roughly 396 lead-form enquiries a month from Meta in the most recent quarter, each measured on genuine enquiries. The company captures urgent service demand and generates new demand at the same time — with PPC Guru able to shift budget to whichever channel delivers the best cost per lead as the season changes.
cta: Run an HVAC or home-services business? PPC Guru builds full-funnel Google and Meta programmes measured on genuine leads, with transparent reporting.
methodology: Figures are pulled directly from EcoCare's Google Ads and Meta accounts. Google leads are genuine calls and forms (local actions excluded); Meta leads are instant-form enquiries. 'Now' is the most recent complete quarter (Apr–Jun 2026). The two channels are reported separately because their lead types and intent differ.
teaser: 📈 HVAC omnichannel: PPC Guru runs EcoCare Home Comfort on Google + Meta — ~14 high-intent call leads/mo from Search and ~396 lead-forms/mo from Meta (Q2 2026), budget following the leads.
